lede: The biggest thing on the table this week is Tuesday's Telluride Town Council meeting, where the Fourth Supplement to the Gondola IGA goes up for a vote — that's the cost-sharing agreement that keeps 2027 planning money flowing on the gondola replacement — plus first readings of two ordinances touching the Energy Mitigation Program. Over in Ouray County, commissioners are deep into an EMS-Ridgway Fire merger discussion and a fifth extension of their Emergency Disaster Declaration, while the gondola's federal funding pursuit gets an airing Monday at the SMART Advisory Committee.

notable.stake: Council votes on gondola IGA supplement and two ordinances get first reading.
Ouray BOCC votes on fifth Emergency Disaster Declaration extension and vacancy fills.
EMS and Ridgway Fire merger draft agreement shapes emergency response for years.
Federal funding pipeline update for gondola replacement — public comment open.
